answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 32820 Country: India Title: 1. As business concern my father is doing chillies export business..we will buy the chillies from farmer and we will sell to our customers members . Question: 1. As business concern my father is doing chillies export business..we will buy the chillies from farmer and we will sell to our customers members ..some times we will buy the chillies and we will kept in COLD STORAGE(A.C)..As hadies concern chillies or any food items should be sell before 40 days..this is right or wrong..Please give the answer to my mail ..I think you had under stood this question 2. My mother was so sick patients ..she had one disease like called MOTOR NEURON as similarly..she cannot walk without any support..We had treated number of Doctors..But there advise is there is no cure for it..but as Quran concern..there is cure for it ..So please make a Dua by you with children ...this is not a Question but please make this Answer ID: 32820 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1215/738/D=1432) (1) It is allowable to keep the chillies in the cold storage after purchasing it and to sell it later if the local people do not face any problem in getting the chillies and the rate does not go high. Write the complete text of the hadith referred by you with the reference of the book, then we can have a say in this regard. (2) The advice of the doctors that there is no cure for it is based on their ignorance and lack of knowledge. Almighty Allah has created the medicine of every illness, but it is possible that we do not have access to them. So keep on doing dua, we too shall make dua for you. Also, keep on treating the illness as per your capacity. In-sha-Allah, she shall be cured fully. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
